artists.biography: T'Pau is a British pop group led by singer Carol Decker. They had had a string of Top 40 hits in the UK in the late 1980s, most notably "China in Your Hand" and "Heart and Soul", and several hits in the United States and Europe, before disbanding in the early 1990s. Decker still performs under the name T'Pau at solo shows and 1980s nostalgia concerts.

T'Pau.biography: T'Pau is a British pop group led by singer Carol Decker. They had had a string of Top 40 hits in the UK in the late 1980s, most notably "China in Your Hand" and "Heart and Soul", and several hits in the United States and Europe, before disbanding in the early 1990s. Decker still performs under the name T'Pau at solo shows and 1980s nostalgia concerts.

perplexity.description:
Bridge of Spies, released in 1987 on the Siren label, is the debut album by British rock band T'Pau. The album features a polished rock sound characteristic of the late 1980s, blending catchy melodies with strong vocal performances led by Carol Decker. Its style incorporates elements of mainstream rock and pop, highlighted by prominent guitar work and synthesizers, which helped define the band's accessible yet dynamic musical identity.

As T'Pau's first major release, Bridge of Spies marked a significant entry in their discography, establishing them in the UK music scene. The album achieved notable commercial success, reaching number one on the UK Albums Chart and remaining on the chart for 44 weeks. It includes hit singles such as "Heart and Soul" and "China in Your Hand," which contributed to the album's widespread recognition and enduring popularity. Critically, the album was praised for its strong songwriting and production quality, securing T'Pau's place as a prominent rock act of the era.
